coverage.category: 21. Fuel stations and fuel or LPG distributors
coverage.found: No new 2026 sworn-declaration rule found. Existing duties: Bocas de Expendio registry (Res SE 1102/2004), price and volume reporting module, Res 259/2024 (sign on municipal/road fees), Res 147/2025 (self-service certificate), Res 504/2025 (mobile stations: registry plus volume/price reporting plus safety audit, Dec 2025). Mostly national (Secretaría de Energía) and served by pump/station vendors (not checked). GLP depots fall under a separate national industry registry (not explored). Weak candidates only.

coverage.category: 22. Grain, coffee, cocoa and other commodity traders, millers and warehouses
coverage.found: ARCA RG 5689/2025 (7 May 2025): every plant with at least one active SISA plant must report each grain movement and stock within 24 hours, backed by electronic carta de porte or remito; RUCA dropped; RG 5894/2026 tightens SISA links to IVA refund. National. Coffee and cocoa not applicable to Argentina. Yerba mate (INYM) and rice/other millers not searched. Competitor products (acopio ERPs) not searched.

coverage.category: 23. Co-operatives, credit unions and savings groups
coverage.found: INAES (national) 2025-2026 stream: Res 756/2025 and 2147/2025 member and authorities roll (deadline 11 Dec 2025, expired); Res 1279/2026 monthly web transmission for mutuales with ayuda economica (within 20 business days of month end, from July 2026 period, arrears must also use it); Res 1038/2026 CRS identification of members; Res 1687/2026 30-day cure for lending mutuales; Res 878-879/2024 and 3208/2024 summary proceedings and suspensions for non-filers of assembly documents and accounts. Candidate 2.

coverage.category: 24. Private clinics, labs and other health providers that bill insurers or state schemes
coverage.found: Nothing new beyond K09, K13 and K19 (billing already covered by Traditum and others). Search for REFES and provider registers returned Colombia/Chile noise and no Argentine 2026 rule. Not repeated.

coverage.category: 25. Pharmacies, medicine importers, and users of controlled chemicals or precursors
coverage.found: RENPRE: Decreto 128/2026 (4 Mar 2026) added 56 substances (31 List I, 25 List III, e.g. methyl acetate, cyclohexane, styrene, carbon tetrachloride); Res MSEG 424/2026 (8 May 2026) updated the RENPRE procedures manual; Veriquim sells purchase/receipt registers with RENPRE web service. Pharmacies: ANMAT Disp 6223/2025 widened the traceability list; Ley 27.553 libro recetario may be digital; Decreto 345/2024 substitution recording; ANMAT dropped 45 wholesalers in Jan 2026. No new pharmacy duty. Candidate 3.

coverage.category: 26. Security, cleaning and manpower agencies, and the firms that hire their workers
coverage.found: Only security agencies searched. Private security is provincial: Cordoba Ley 10.571 (annual renewal, notices to renew), Neuquen Ley 2772. No 2026 trigger or vendor found. Cleaning and manpower agencies (servicios eventuales) not searched. Weak candidate only.

coverage.category: 27. Construction, mining and quarry contractors and suppliers: site registers, accreditation, local-content reports
coverage.found: IERIC: Ley 27.802 (labour modernisation) art. 155 and Decreto 407/2026 move construction worker registration exclusively to ARCA; ARCA has 120 days to adapt and exchange data with IERIC, so the IERIC registration duty is shrinking. IERIC Res 50/2025 fines instalment plan (up to 48 instalments, fines up to 31 Jul 2026, adhesion until 31 Jul 2027). Contractor document control already K08 and K12 (Certronic, Exactian). Mining and quarry not searched.

Res UIF 93/2026 reshapes registries of property from 8 Nov 2026 (state registries, out of scope). Insurance producers: SSN REPAS annual fee 2026; AML duty from older SSN Circular 1254. Candidates 1, 10, 11.

coverage.found: EU deforestation regulation postponed again to 30 Dec 2026 (Cancilleria and Ministerio de Agricultura sources); Argentina relies on SAGyP-registered traceability schemes, aims for low-risk classification. Technical safety regimes for importers: Res 16/2025 electrical (DJC via TAD, 2-year certificates), Res 17/2025 tools, toys Res 163/2005 and conformity mark deadlines of 2025, Res 313/2025 food-contact. coverage.category: 31. Wine and vine sector (INV): grape intake, harvest and production declarations
coverage.found: Found via INV rules: Res INV 3/2025 (CIU grape intake declaration within 48 h), Res 35/2020 harvest system (weekly CEC-01, annual CEC-05, CEC-04), home winemakers declaration before 1 June each year, 5-year retention, Clave Fiscal access at servicios.inv.gob.ar. National register (Mendoza, San Juan, Salta etc. run local offices). Candidate 4.

coverage.category: 32. Firearms, ammunition and controlled materials dealers (ANMaC)
coverage.found: Armerias must log firearms daily in SIGIMAC-MUCOM (Disp 643/2012) and ammunition and special materials in official paper books, with periodic reports to ANMaC; Res 149/2024 security conditions for showrooms; Res 45/2025 Tenencia Express via MiAnmac. No private compliance software found. Candidate 5.

Candidate 6.

coverage.found: SSN 2026 annual registry fee for individual producers ARS 33,000 via REPAS, due 30 Apr 2026, 50 percent surcharge after; Res SSN 194/2026 admissions. AML duties rest on SSN Circular 1254/2006 and Ley 25.246. No new trigger. Weak candidate 10.

coverage.category: 35. Imports under technical safety regulations (electrical, toys, food-contact)
coverage.found: See category 30. Candidate 14.
